chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 33: Ji Ning's Victory Shakes Black-White College – The Senior Disciples Rally
chapter_meta_description: After Ji Ning wins two consecutive matches, the senior disciples recruit their strongest fighter Qinghe and even Wanxiang-level Reincarnated Immortals take notice. The battle lines are drawn.
og_title: Ji Ning's Victory Shakes Black-White College – The Real Fight Begins
og_description: After two defeats, the senior disciples of Black-White College rally their top fighters against the new prodigy Ji Ning. Enter Qinghe and the mysterious Fire Fairy Yu Wei.
twitter_title: Ji Ning wins twice – now the senior disciples are calling in their #1. Black-White College is about to get spicy.
